text:
vicky: opened PR to update SOC2 + audit export docs, removed literal sample keys, added jsonl/curl examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/947

omar: Link?

vicky: includes wording change: use 'retention period' not 'TTL', add note about backups.

sophie: I'll add the Bash/curl snippet for support. Keep examples showing 90 days by default.

omar: I'll update the Rust SDK snippet to use client.audit.export. Quick check: do we need ISO interval example?

vicky: Add a one-line note: "You can provide ISO 8601 duration (e.g., P30D) to specify intervals."

sophie: Pushed curl commit: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"account","retention_days":90,"format":"jsonl"}' > export.jsonl
```

omar: Rust example added: ```rust
let client = redwood::Client::new();
for rec in client.audit().export("account", Some(90)) {
    println!("{}", rec);
}
```

ci-bot: Linkcheck: found two redirects: /sdk/rust -> /sdk/rust/quickstart, /docs/backup -> /policies/backup. CI: https://ci.redwood/links/947

vicky: Fixing links and adjusting phrasing: replace 'destroyed' -> 'deleted from active storage' and add backup parenthetical.

sophie: LGTM from docs. CI green after fixes.

vicky: Merged. I'll add changelog entry and notify support about the example changes.
